description: Takes back a gift reservation, given the list's share link, the product's Plendio id and the reservation_token returned when the gift was reserved. Only the holder of the token can undo a reservation. A product that is not reserved under the token is reported and left as it is. The product becomes free for other givers.

market.description: Market for the urls in the answer: dk, se, de or no. Default: the market the list was made for.

product_id.description: Plendio product id of the gift to give back.

reservation_token.description: The reservation_token returned when the gift was reserved.

share_url.description: The wishlist's share link, or the share id at the end of it.

name: unreserve_gift

list_title.description: The list's name, written by whoever made it.

reservation_token.description: Keep this: it undoes the reservation and reserves more products under the same name. Anyone holding it can give the product back.

reserved.description: True when the product is now reserved under the token; false after an unreserve.

url.description: The product's page on Plendio, listing all its offers.

title: Undo a gift reservation
